subtitle: Web Cinema Gateway — Embedded Viewing & Saved Video Links
changes: Added the compact Web Cinema Gateway as one optional expandable section within the existing Video Vault, with no new studio or extra ORBIT navigation tab

Provided a safe in-site website viewer for HTTPS pages that allow embedding, with isolated iframe permissions, browser-level Back/Forward/Reload controls, fullscreen and an explicit Open Externally fallback

Added compatible online video playback using official YouTube privacy-enhanced and Vimeo embed players, plus native direct MP4, WebM, MOV and HLS links where the current browser supports the source and codec

Recognizes unsupported or restricted providers and HTTP pages with a clear external-opening option instead of bypassing embed permissions, authentication, DRM, platform restrictions or browser security

Added a browser-local library of up to 180 saved video and website URLs with titles, editable collections, favorites, search, replay, recently opened sorting and no automatic external requests on site startup
Remembers direct-file video playback position when a link is saved; third-party providers retain their own player behavior and may not support independent resume controls
Included explicitly initiated JSON import/export and opted-in settings backup portability for saved link metadata, without copying, downloading or storing remote video files

Optimized iPhone and PC layouts to keep the Gateway collapsed by default, unload third-party embeds when leaving or closing it, and preserve all existing Video Vault, Sonic Theater and release automation features
